method.algorithm: experiments/wit/shared/compute.rs: two sequential awaits; wrapped i32 host addition, same 3507 inputs and all actual I/O
method.sync_control: experiments/async-size/sync.rs: same arithmetic and host I/O, synchronous Rust; selected backend glue still included
method.optimization: release z/LTO/1CGU; CLI then identical Binaryen 133 Oz/flatten/rereloop/Oz/converge on every deployed core; all required JS bundled/minified with esbuild es2022
method.runtime_size: all deployed JS + all required core Wasm, independently gzip9/brotli11; no declarations or Component container double-counting
method.allocation: primary rows all taraba-allocator without size classes; wee_alloc without size classes is a separate allocator control
method.scope: common successful arithmetic/I/O only; JSPI serialization, canonical typed errors, and Future cancellation/Drop contracts are not equivalent
method.official_embassy: platform-wasm + executor-thread; upstream links std (critical-section/std); no no_std result is claimed; JsFuture bridges host I/O and Embassy drives its static 1024-worker pool
method.tokio: rt only, one current-thread Runtime and LocalSet per instance; a persistent wasm-bindgen driver polls LocalSet inside a Tokio block_on whose root immediately returns Poll; JS wakers resume later, so no blocking/idle park or timer/net/multithread features are used; safe custom bridge is included
method.async_executor: one LocalExecutor per instance; persistent wasm-bindgen spawn_local drives run(pending), LocalExecutor.spawn schedules compute and its Task is joined; no smol I/O reactor is claimed
method.async_std: default features plus unstable for task::spawn_local; upstream WASM branch uses wasm-bindgen-futures and a channel JoinHandle; async-std 1.13.2 is deprecated and is included as a historical compatibility control
method.futures_unordered: alloc/async-await, std only in std rows; per-invocation FuturesUnordered containing one compute Future, driven by StreamExt::next and wasm-bindgen; a task collection reference, not an independent runtime/reactor
